sources.title: Bears NFL Draft 2026: Chicago selects Zavion Thomas, Wide Receiver, LSU
sources.description: The Bears have added Zavion Thomas, a wide receiver from LSU, in the third round, and he brings his 4.28 forty speed to the Windy City.
